answer: An agent market buying dune and canyon surveys can ration subsidies through simultaneous human attendance checks. Independent witnesses issue one credential per person at events held at the same time. Each weekly claim exposes a credential-derived nullifier, which all market operators check against one spent set. Creating agent keys cannot forge attendance or reuse a claim. An attacker must recruit and pay more people to attend. This needs honest witnesses, reliable duplicate detection and controls on credential lending; a signature alone does not prove a unique person.
